issues.title: External Error Code Registry Reference Missing
issues.why: AC-SC-22 and 02-features/02 reference spec/03-error-manage for AB-9301+ codes, but the provided context only includes spec/06. An AI coder cannot verify if these codes exist or conflict.
issues.fix: Provide the registry file from spec/03 or explicitly define the AB-9300 block as reserved for RAG in the overview.

issues.title: Ambiguous SQLite DDL for SettingValue Union
issues.why: AC-SC-14 defines a complex Go union struct (SettingValue) but the SQL DDL in 01-fundamentals uses a single 'Value TEXT' column without specifying if it's JSON-encoded or a flat string for scalars.
issues.fix: Explicitly state in the DDL comments that 'Value' column MUST store the JSON-serialized representation of the SettingValue struct.

issues.title: Inconsistent Type naming in 01-fundamentals
issues.why: 01-fundamentals §config.schema.json uses 'Type' (Pascal) while the JSON Schema in 00-overview uses 'type' (lowercase) for JSON-native types, potentially confusing the PascalCase-only rule.
issues.fix: Standardize the JSON Schema fragments to use lowercase 'type' for JSON Schema keywords while keeping PascalCase for property keys.
